lines.text: During the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra, a descendant of Aaron, came up from Babylon.
Ezra left Babylon in the first month and reached Jerusalem on the first day of the seventh month.
Ezra set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach it in Israel.
The king and his twelve counselors sent Ezra to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem, and to buy bulls, rams, and lambs.
Ezra blessed the LORD, the God of his fathers, and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with him.
